item.title: Müller takes pole for Miami E-Prix
item.description: Nico Müller claimed his first Formula E pole position at the Miami E-Prix, beating Felipe Drugovich in the Duels final at the Miami International Autodrome.

item.title: Racing on TV, January 30-February 2, 2026
item.description: NASCAR returns with the Clash at Bowman Gray, Formula E in Miami, Asian Le Mans, King of the Hammers on RACER Network.

item.title: Müller pleased to earn his first podium for Porsche
item.description: Despite starting from pole, Müller wasn’t too disheartened to miss out on the Miami E-Prix win as he got his first podium for Porsche’s factory team.

item.title: Hamilton feeling buoyed by Ferrari vibes after topping Barcelona times
item.description: Lewis Hamilton says he feels “the winning mentality” within Ferrari and its personnel more than ever after completing a productive week of running with its 2026 car at the Barcelona shakedown.

item.title: IndyCar announces Freedom 250 GP of Washington, D.C. as 18th race
item.description: The IndyCar Series has expanded its 17-race calendar for 2026 to include a brand-new street race around Washington, D.C. as part of the country’s 250th birthday celebrations.

item.title: NTSB releases preliminary report on Biffle plane crash
item.description: Greg Biffle was not flying the plane that took his life and that of six others when it crashed in Statesville, N.C., in December.

item.title: Evans breaks Formula E's all-time wins record with victory at Miami E-Prix

item.title: NASCAR postpones Clash until Monday due to winter storm
item.description: The Cook Out Clash at Bowman Gray Stadium has been postponed until Monday due to the winter storm Gianna, which is dumping snow across the Southeast.

item.title: Evans resets Jaguar’s season with surprise Miami win
item.description: Mitch Evans is counting on his win in the Miami E-Prix to help Jaguar "reset its season" after a torrid start to the Formula E campaign.
